company.name: BioPulse Health
company.vision: To eliminate clinical trial attrition through predictive continuous biometric monitoring and decentralized patient adherence analytics.

context.brief: BioPulse Health provides a continuous biometric telemetry and adherence platform for Phase II/III clinical trials. Trial sponsors lose up to $4M per study due to unmonitored patient dropouts and non-compliance.
context.target_customer: VP of Clinical Operations and Principal Investigators at mid-sized biopharma and CRO sponsors.
context.value_prop: Real-time adherence telemetry that cuts clinical trial dropouts by 40%.
